description: This file defines the FooTable.State component, which manages the state (filtering, paging, sorting) of a FooTable instance, including methods for storing, retrieving, and clearing state data, as well as generating unique identifiers.

classes.name: FooTable.State
classes.description: A component that manages the state of a FooTable instance, including filtering, paging, and sorting states, with methods for persistence and retrieval.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Initializes the state component, setting up configuration based on the table options.

methods.name: preinit
methods.description: Checks and applies the supplied data and options for the state component before UI creation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves stored state data for a given key from localStorage.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores state data for a given key into localStorage.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes stored state data for a given key from localStorage.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Executes the readState method on all components.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Executes the writeState method on all components.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Executes the clearState method on all components.

methods.name: _uid
methods.description: Generates a unique identifier for the table, based on URL hash and element ID or a global counter.
